Loading in packages and data:

```{r}
#| include: false

install.packages("gtsummary")
install.packages("tidytuesdayR")
install.packages("ggplot2")
library("gtsummary")
library("tidytuesdayR")
library("ggplot2")

tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2026-06-09')
game_films <- tuesdata$game_films
rm(tuesdata)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#creating summary table of descriptive statistics:

tbl_summary(
  game_films,
  by = category,
  include = c(
    budget_low, budget_high, category,
    rotten_tomatoes, metacritic, worldwide_box_office))

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

#making a ratings scatterplot:

ggplot(data = game_films, aes(x = metacritic, y = rotten_tomatoes)) + geom_point() + labs(x= "Metacritic Score", y = "Rotten Tomatoes Score",                                          title = "Video Game Movie Ratings")
```
